about: Books, shows, restaurants and more that people tell you about, who suggested each, and whether you've tried it.

table.name: Recommendations
table.description: Books, shows, restaurants and anything else someone recommended, and who it came from.
conventions: Title is the thing itself as it is known: the book's title, the restaurant's name. Not 'Book Sam recommended'.
Recommended By is who suggested it, as they named them; empty when they found it themselves.
One recording can hold several: 'Sam recommended Severance and the book Piranesi' is two creates.

When they say they tried one ('finally watched Severance, it was great'), update that existing row with Tried = true and put what they thought in Notes. Never add a second copy of something already listed.
Date is when it was recommended: the recording's date, set when the row is created. An update never changes it.
